other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage in cross-validation
other_failure_modes.description: The out-of-fold target encoding is performed before the model cross-validation loop using the exact same KFold splits. This causes a severe data leak: a training row's encoded feature is computed using the validation fold's target, meaning the model's training features directly contain information about the validation target.

summary: While the agent demonstrates advanced techniques like target encoding and model stacking, the execution introduces critical data leakage. Specifically, applying target encoding prior to model cross-validation using the same folds leaks validation targets into the training features, fundamentally invalidating the CV scores. Additionally, test set statistics are leaked into the training data during feature engineering, and the meta-model's performance is optimistically reported on its own training data.
